```{r setup, include=FALSE}

if(file.exists('squba_example_results.tar.gz') & 
	 !dir.exists('amia_squba_sampledata')){
	untar('squba_example_results.tar.gz',
				exdir = 'amia_squba_sampledata')
}

if(dir.exists('amia_squba_sampledata/masked_results')){
	dir_header <- 'amia_squba_sampledata/masked_results/'
	header_new <- 'amia_squba_sampledata/'
	
	mod_list <- c('ca','cnc_sp','csd','cvd','dr','evp',
								'pes','pf','prc','qvd','scv','ssc','uc')
	
	for(k in mod_list){
		file.rename(paste0(dir_header, k),
								paste0(header_new, k))
	}
	
	unlink(dir_header, recursive = TRUE)
}

```
